description: Runs one of Monte's solvers and returns every answer with its working, exactly as the solver page shows it. Inputs you leave out keep the solver's defaults. Numbers may be written as 0.7, 70% or 7/10.

inputs.description: Input key to value, as text, for example {"mu": "500", "sd": "20"}

solver.description: Solver id from list_solvers, like tree, normal or ci

name: solve
title: Solve a problem
